title: Winter cabin and sled

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Make season visible through activity and clothing so viewers can understand context without a caption.
strategic_value: A bundled figure pulling a sled toward a blue cabin can give Helsinki winter communications a welcoming human scene.
demonstration: A large blue cabin sits right, with smaller landscape fragments, a sled-pulling figure and blue chairs and table on gray.
practical_value: Use the cabin and sled group to suggest winter while reserving space for text elsewhere.
